_doc: P0 part 1 (docs/v3/P0-animation-proof.md): unseen story lines (not in the prompt) and the relations each must give, hand-written. A word in a check matches an entity by its name / noun / known person. Checks: [posture, who, p] · [rel, a, rel, b(, c)] · [op, op, actor, target(, value)] · [speak, who, to, words] · [known, who, k] · [any, check, check ...] · [not, check]. [same, word] (pairs): the entity of that word keeps its id from the first line.

The teacher pointed at the map.
